name_zh: 因纽特/格陵兰自治：极地自治治理与资源联邦制
name_en: Inuit/Greenland Self-Governance: Polar Autonomy Governance & Resource Federalism
description_zh: 格陵兰 1979 自治/2009 自治法/因纽特人主导/库亚纳克/石油/稀土/铀/渔业/旅游/丹麦补贴/气候/冰盖融化/北极航道/北极理事会/因纽特环极会议。核心模式：极地自治联邦制 — 因纽特自治/丹麦联邦/资源收益共享/气候适应/原住民权利/北极地缘。体现 M208 极地自治联邦制 — 以"因纽特自治+丹麦联邦+资源联邦+气候前哨"四位一体，在冰盖融化/资源争夺/大国博弈/原住民权利四重约束中构建极地自治范式。
description_en: Greenland 1979 home rule/2009 Self-Government Act/Inuit-led/Kuannersuit/oil/rare earths/uranium/fisheries/tourism/Danish subsidies/climate/ice melt/Arctic routes/Arctic Council/Inuit Circumpolar Council. Core model: polar autonomy federalism — Inuit autonomy/Danish federation/resource revenue sharing/climate adaptation/indigenous rights/Arctic geopolitics. Exemplifies M208 Polar Autonomy Federalism — quaternity of 'Inuit autonomy + Danish federation + resource federalism + climate outpost' building polar autonomy paradigm amid quadruple constraints of ice melt/resource scramble/great power games/indigenous rights.
reason_zh: 格陵兰非单纯自治领，而是"因纽特自治+丹麦联邦+资源联邦"三位一体极地实验。因纽特人通过自治法夺回资源/立法/司法/警察权，丹麦保留外交/国防/货币，资源收益分成支撑福利。M208 区隔于 M170 联邦制(加拿大)、M176 萨米协商(北欧)、M195 永久中立(土库曼)，核心在于"原住民自治+宗主国联邦+资源联邦+气候前哨"的极地自治新范式。
reason_en: Greenland not mere autonomous territory but 'Inuit autonomy + Danish federation + resource federalism' trinity polar experiment. Inuit reclaimed resource/legislative/judicial/police powers via Self-Government Act, Denmark retains foreign/defense/currency, resource revenue sharing funds welfare. M208 distinct from M170 Federalism (Canada), M176 Sami Consultation (Nordic), M195 Permanent Neutrality (Turkmenistan), core: 'indigenous autonomy + metropolitan federation + resource federalism + climate outpost' new polar autonomy paradigm.
steps_zh: 因纽特自治立法进程：1979 自治/2009 自治法/立法/司法/警察/资源/环境/教育/文化/丹麦保留外交/国防/货币
资源联邦制与收益共享：库亚纳克稀土/石油/铀/锌/渔业配额/收益分成/主权财富基金/福利支撑/环境红线/原住民同意
气候前哨与适应治理：冰盖融化/海平面/永久冻土/北极航道/因纽特传统知识/社区搬迁/适应基金/北极理事会领袖
丹麦联邦与外交平衡：丹麦补贴 30%+ GDP/外交/国防/货币/欧盟/北约/美国/中国/俄罗斯/北极地缘/四面周旋
因纽特环极团结与权利：因纽特环极会议 ICC/联合国原住民权利宣言/跨国因纽特/语言/文化/狩猎/航海/权利捍卫
steps_en: Inuit autonomy legislative process: 1979 home rule/2009 Self-Government Act/legislative/judicial/police/resource/environment/education/culture/Denmark retains foreign/defense/currency
Resource federalism & revenue sharing: Kuannersuit rare earths/oil/uranium/zinc/fisheries quotas/revenue sharing/SWF/welfare funding/environmental redlines/FPIC
Climate outpost & adaptation governance: ice melt/sea level/permafrost/Arctic routes/Inuit traditional knowledge/community relocation/adaptation funds/Arctic Council leadership
Danish federation & diplomatic balance: Danish subsidy 30%+ GDP/foreign/defense/currency/EU/NATO/US/China/Russia/Arctic geopolitics/four-way maneuvering
Inuit circumpolar solidarity & rights: Inuit Circumpolar Council ICC/UN Declaration on Indigenous Rights/transnational Inuit/language/culture/hunting/navigation/rights defense
expected_zh: 以"因纽特自治+丹麦联邦+资源联邦+气候前哨"四位一体，在冰盖融化/资源争夺/大国博弈/原住民权利四重约束中构建极地自治范式，为北极原住民自治提供样本。
expected_en: Quaternity of 'Inuit autonomy + Danish federation + resource federalism + climate outpost' builds polar autonomy paradigm amid quadruple constraints of ice melt/resource scramble/great power games/indigenous rights, providing sample for Arctic indigenous autonomy.
